objective: On the deterministic clean UNSB baseline, use long-horizon evidence from multiple probe families to discover and reconstruct a new algorithm capable of retaining matched benefit over 200 data epochs.
guarantees: at least one evidence-derived route-1 candidate and one current-best fallback
traceable code, data, configuration, checkpoint and evaluation identities
non_guarantees: positive PSNR or successful reproduction of historical methods
completion of the original 400-epoch UNSB schedule

authorization_required.scope: supplementary host-matched small25 route1 replica after preflight

change_policy: Every new algorithm requires an evidence-linked derivation card and frozen local protocol before its paired target metrics are read. Server execution remains suspended until an explicit user decision.
